name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.14.0 uses the current Codex model for bounded interactive image comparison: one tool returns up to six safe candidate images and a second validates structured evidence from the same immutable, single-use snapshot. Visual conflicts fail closed and visual evidence can never create EXACT identity. Text search remains a one-call path, while Watch and batch checks skip image reranking. No external visual model or visual-service credentials are required. Exact selected-product follow-ups still reuse stable selection identity. Affiliate relationships never affect eligibility or ranking. Price-history and buy-or-wait forecasting remain disabled. Authorized bounded Chrome search remains a user-approved fallback only after eligible API searches return no usable result. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
